title_en: Jobs (2/20): Up in the Sky with a Pilot
note_en: Chinese marks a concession at both ends: 虽然今天的天气不太好，但是经过仔细检查，我们确定可以安全起飞. English uses either "although" or "but," never both, yet in Chinese the second clause normally still needs 但是 (or 可是, 却), and leaving it out sounds unfinished. The same pairing returns later: 虽然自动化程度越来越高，但是……
